C5: only fewer bytes. fresh 1.001 (equivalent) / noop 0.991 (inconclusive). The compression change (c9e8d5d5f87d against 0a4953bec5d8) did not make copies faster on this link. Fresh copies were 'fresh 1.001 (equivalent)', 95% interval 0.974 to 1.030 over 8 blocks, at 12.42 s against 12.402 s. No-op re-syncs were 'noop 0.991 (inconclusive)', interval 0.942 to 1.043 over 8 blocks, at 1.714 s against 1.73 s. Eight blocks is the minimum. The fresh interval is reasonably tight around 1, but the no-op interval is wide, so this is weak evidence in both directions. The race also ran on mac-mars-usb10g, not on lab2's internet link, so it says nothing for or against the 'faster on lab2' branch. On the 10 GbE cable, where negative levels were meant to help, it bought no time. No later node depends on it. Drop it from the chain; the dictionary and long-range ideas would need a separate slow-link race.
